newsitem.title: UK: Boeing announces major airline sales orders.
newsitem.headline: Boeing announces major airline sales orders.

text.p: Boeing Co announced on Monday a package of new aircraft sales together worth $6.3 billion.

It said orders included the launch sale for a bigger version of its 757 twin jet, the 757-300X which has 20 percent more capacity. The 757 order is from German holiday airline Condor Flugdienst in a deal for 12 aircraft plus 12 options worth about $800 million.
Boeing said the orders also include sales to British Finance Corp, Airtours, Air Berlin, LOT Polish Airlines, Maersk Air and TACA.
The BA order is for four 747-400s, three 777-200s and three 757-200s. The British carrier also reconfirmed orders for 10 747-400s, bringing delivery forward to replace older 747-100s.

Australian leasing firm Ansett Worldwide has bought ten 737-700s, six 737-300s and nine 767-300 ERs (extended range 'planes). U.S. leasing giant ILFC has acquired 156 aircraft including five 757-200s, five 767-300 ERs and five 737s.
LOT has bought two 737-400s and one 767-300 ER, Danish carrier Maersk has acquired three 737-500s, Air Berlin bought one 737-400 and British holiday firm Airtours one 767-300 ER.
